name: Henry Lee's
reviews: Had a really enjoyable brunch at Henry Lee's! The highlight was definitely the waffle dessert—super crispy with a rich coffee sauce that wasn't overly sweet, paired perfectly with vanilla ice cream. The XO prawn noodles were flavourful with just a mild kick, and the salmon with corn fritter was fresh and well-balanced. We also loved the fresh juice and watermelon Yakult, both very refreshing. Great food, friendly service, and a lovely atmosphere. Will definitely be back! 😊

Such a wonderful experience! The staff were incredibly warm and friendly — they even gave my little one a croissant and kept him entertained, which as a parent means the world. The food was delicious too. Will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

We came here on the strength of its reputation, and overall, it was a great experience.

Although I had made a reservation at 1pm, perhaps because it was raining, I arrived early at 12:30pm and found that there was no line. I was seated right away, dishes came very fast and we started eating shortly after ordering.

Aside from the croissant—which I personally found just average because the filling was cold—everything else was quite good.

I'd definitely recommend it. I'll be back if I get the chance!

Good location for Redfern area. Quite and best place for gatherings the food were good however the coffee I ordered was not to coffee I would recommend. They kinda mixup with my coffee for cappuccino when I ordered flat white.

It's a good location and would love to revisit for a meal.
Recommended!!

Henry Lee's is a nice place for brunch!  I love Smells Like Crab Spirit as it is so tasty. I also love Fritter Sweet Symphony as salmon go well with crispy corn fritters and creamy avocado, so unique and so delicious. Waffle Like Jagger is a kind of dessert that absolutely scrumptious!  Sakura Jelly Lemonade is so refreshing and Lychee is very luscious. Iced Matcha Latte is  super creamy and rich. The staff there are very friendly and quick. I would like to eat at Henry Lee's more often!
